title: Let’s pray two rak‘ahs
intro: Put it all together: a prayer of two rak‘ahs, like the Fajr prayer.

learn.html: Now we know the positions and what we recite. Let’s put them together into a prayer of two rak‘ahs – like the Fajr prayer.

items: Niyyah – in our heart we know which prayer we are praying
Allaahu akbar – the opening takbir, raising the hands
1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka → A‘udhu → Bismillah → Al-Fatiha → Ameen → a short surah
Ruku‘ → standing up → sajdah → short sitting → sajdah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah → Al-Fatiha → Ameen → a short surah
Ruku‘ → standing up → sajdah → short sitting → sajdah
Salam to the right, then to the left

learn.title: 🌅 The Fajr prayer
learn.html: Fajr has 4 rak‘ahs: first 2 sunnah, then 2 fard. Both are prayed just like this.
Play: Build the Salah – level 1 is the Fajr prayer.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: In the 2nd rak‘ah we do not recite Subhanaka – we start with Bismillah.

practice.title: Two rak‘ahs in order
practice.prompt: Tap the steps of a two-rak‘ah prayer in order.

practice.title: What do we recite in the 2nd rak‘ah?
practice.prompt: Tap everything we recite while standing in the 2nd rak‘ah.

options.why: Subhanaka is only in the first rak‘ah.
At-Tahiyyat is recited sitting, not standing.
